newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Telecom 1st-half net profit up 13.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Telecom 1st-half net profit up 13.6 pct.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) announced on Friday a 13.6 percent rise in first half net profits to Singapore $843.5 million (US$602.5 million), from S$742.5 million a year ago.
SingTel, Southeast Asia's biggest listed telecoms group, said in a statement its turnover grew 10.5 pct in the six months to September 30, 1996 to S$2.17 billion, from S$1.96 billion.

The half year continued to witness strong growth in the mobile communications and leased circuit businesses. The growth in the volume of international calls, although satisfactory, has not been as robust as the growth in the same period last year.
This was a reflection of the slower growth in the singapore economy, the statement quoted Singapore Telecom chairman Koh Boon Hwee as saying.
"Despite the anticipated slower economic growth in the next few quarters, Singapore Telecom is confident of mainitaining its double digit earnings growth for the full year," he said.
